distinctive_concordance: Stout central root mass with several broad tapering descending branches.
A narrow pale central shaft meets the root at a conspicuous rounded collar containing round marks.
Lowest paired green leaves are broad and nearly circular, with scalloped margins and notched petiole entry.
Pale arched petioles penetrate the leaf blade and curl downward within it.
counter_features: Root paint is brown on f37v and red/orange on fragment203.
Root branches have different proportions and bends; this is not a traced silhouette.
f37v has a long multi-level paired-leaf axis and three terminal blue/red head structures; fragment203 retains only two large round leaves and a short upper shaft.
The omitted upper structures could reflect simplified drawing or growth stage rather than anatomical excision.
herbal_anatomical_extent: FLOWER_BEARING_FULL_PLANT_DRAWING: root, long axis, multiple paired leaf levels, three terminal heads
fragment_anatomical_extent: LEAF_BEARING_ROOT_AND_SHORT_AXIS: root with lowest paired round leaves; upper axis ends without terminal heads
